name: Adsorption metal charge
description: Signed Bader charge on the adsorption metal; positive means electron deficiency.

name: Partner metal charge
description: Signed Bader charge on the other metal.

name: Metal separation
description: Cartesian separation between the two metals.

name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand dipole magnitude
description: Mean of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: spread ligand dipole magnitude
description: Spread of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: minimum ligand dipole magnitude
description: Minimum of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: maximum ligand dipole magnitude
description: Maximum of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: net ligand dipole magnitude
description: Magnitude of the signed vector sum of ligand charge moments around this metal; includes directional cancellation.

name: Adsorption metal: total ligand charge
description: Total of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand charge
description: Mean of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: spread ligand charge
description: Spread of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: minimum ligand charge
description: Smallest signed Bader charge on the selected N/O/S neighbors; the most negative ligand charge.

name: Adsorption metal: maximum ligand charge
description: Maximum of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand spin magnitude
description: Mean of absolute atomic magnetic moments on the selected N/O/S neighbors.

name: Adsorption metal: total ligand spin magnitude
description: Total of absolute atomic magnetic moments on the selected N/O/S neighbors.

name: Partner metal: mean ligand dipole magnitude
description: Mean of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: spread ligand dipole magnitude
description: Spread of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: minimum ligand dipole magnitude
description: Minimum of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: maximum ligand dipole magnitude
description: Maximum of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: net ligand dipole magnitude
description: Magnitude of the signed vector sum of ligand charge moments around this metal; includes directional cancellation.

name: Partner metal: total ligand charge
description: Total of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: mean ligand charge
description: Mean of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: spread ligand charge
description: Spread of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: minimum ligand charge
description: Smallest signed Bader charge on the selected N/O/S neighbors; the most negative ligand charge.

name: Partner metal: maximum ligand charge
description: Maximum of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

name: Partner metal: mean ligand spin magnitude
description: Mean of absolute atomic magnetic moments on the selected N/O/S neighbors.

name: Partner metal: total ligand spin magnitude
description: Total of absolute atomic magnetic moments on the selected N/O/S neighbors.

name: Mean ligand angle at adsorption metal
description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

name: Spread of ligand angle at adsorption metal
description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

name: Smallest ligand angle at adsorption metal
description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

name: Largest ligand angle at adsorption metal
description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

name: Mean metal-bridge-metal angle
description: Mean angle at each shared ligand between vectors pointing to the two metals.

name: Spread of metal-bridge-metal angles
description: Population standard deviation of the angles at shared bridging ligands.

name: Mean bridge dipole magnitude asymmetry
description: Mean absolute difference between a shared ligand's charge-moment magnitudes about the two metals.

name: Adsorption metal spin magnitude
description: Absolute calculated atomic magnetic moment of the adsorption metal.

name: Partner metal spin magnitude
description: Absolute calculated atomic magnetic moment of the other metal.

name: Signed metal spin product
description: Product of signed metal magnetic moments; opposite signs give a negative product.

name: Net support spin
description: Signed sum of magnetic moments over every atom except the two metals, including carbon and hydrogen.

name: Total support spin magnitude
description: Sum of absolute magnetic moments over every atom except the two metals.

name: Ligand nonplanarity
description: RMS perpendicular ligand displacement from the best-fit plane; requires at least three selected ligands.

name: Metal displacement from ligand plane
description: Absolute distance of adsorption metal from the best-fit ligand plane.

name: Shared ligand count
description: Number of N/O/S ligands within 2.30 Angstrom of both metals.

name: Terminal ligand count
description: Number of selected adsorption-metal ligands that do not neighbor the partner metal.

name: Adsorption metal: mean shared ligand charge
description: Mean signed Bader charge of shared ligands in this metal's shell.

name: Adsorption metal: mean terminal ligand charge
description: Mean signed Bader charge of terminal ligands in this metal's shell.

name: Partner metal: mean shared ligand charge
description: Mean signed Bader charge of shared ligands in this metal's shell.

name: Partner metal: mean terminal ligand charge
description: Mean signed Bader charge of terminal ligands in this metal's shell.

name: Second-shell carbon density near 2.8 Angstrom
description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

name: Second-shell carbon density near 3.6 Angstrom
description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

name: Second-shell N/O/S density near 2.8 Angstrom
description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

name: Second-shell N/O/S density near 3.6 Angstrom
description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

name: Mean ligand angle at partner metal
description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

name: Spread of ligand angle at partner metal
description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

name: Smallest ligand angle at partner metal
description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

name: Largest ligand angle at partner metal
description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

name: Metal-pair axial charge dipole
description: Metal-only Bader-charge dipole about the metal-pair midpoint, projected toward the adsorption metal. q_s and q_p are the signed Bader charges; d_sp is the metal separation.

name: Adsorption metal Bader electron population
description: Stored Bader electron population for the adsorption metal from the DFT structure data. This is an electron count, not the signed Bader charge.

name: Adsorption metal-ligand spin product
description: Signed product of the adsorption metal moment and the mean signed magnetic moment of its selected N/O/S ligands within 2.30 Angstrom. It is an alignment descriptor, not an exchange energy.
